scope: Self-authored actual Excel VBA Worksheets.Add Count coercion, typed return values, complete errors and worksheet/Saved state; repeated in independent Excel processes and opposite orders. Not a complete Sheets.Add contract.
program:
Attribute VB_Name = "SheetAddCountOracle"
Option Explicit
Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long, ByVal inputPath As String) As Variant
    Dim book As Object, anchor As Object, added As Object
    Dim countValue As Variant, errorCode As Long, errorText As String
    Dim errorSource As String, names As String, i As Long, addedIndex As Long
    Set book = Workbooks.Open(inputPath, 0, True)
    Set anchor = book.Worksheets(1)
    book.Saved = True
    Select Case mode
    Case 1: countValue = 2
    Case 2: countValue = 1.5
    Case 3: countValue = 2.5
    Case 4: countValue = 2.1
    Case 5: countValue = 0
    Case 6: countValue = -1
    Case 7: countValue = Empty
    Case 8: countValue = Null
    Case 9: countValue = "2"
    Case 10: countValue = "bad"
    Case 11: countValue = Array(1)
    Case 12: countValue = True
    Case 14: countValue = CDate(2)
    Case 15: countValue = CVErr(2042)
    Case 16: Set countValue = Nothing
    Case 17: countValue = Array(2)
    Case 18: countValue = Array()
    Case 19: countValue = Array(Null)
    Case 20: countValue = Array(True)
    Case 21: countValue = False
    Case 22: countValue = -0.5
    Case 23: countValue = 0.5
    Case 24: countValue = "2.9"
    Case 25: countValue = " 2 "
    Case 26: countValue = "&H2"
    Case 27: countValue = "1,000"
    Case 28: countValue = Array(2, 1)
    Case 29: countValue = Array(Array(2))
    Case 30: countValue = 0.99
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    If mode = 0 Then
        Set added = book.Worksheets.Add(After:=anchor)
    ElseIf mode = 13 Then
        Set added = book.Worksheets.Add(Before:=anchor, After:=anchor)
    Else
        Set added = book.Worksheets.Add(After:=anchor, Count:=countValue)
    End If
    errorCode = Err.Number
    errorText = Err.Description
    errorSource = Err.Source
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    For i = 1 To book.Worksheets.Count
        names = names & "|" & book.Worksheets(i).Name
    Next i
    If Not added Is Nothing Then addedIndex = added.Index
    Probe = Array(errorCode, errorText, errorSource, TypeName(added), added Is Nothing, book.Worksheets.Count, VarType(book.Worksheets.Count), book.Saved, VarType(book.Saved), names, book.ActiveSheet.Index, addedIndex, VarType(countValue))
    book.Close False
End Function
